properties.name: German Reich
properties.note: Includes Austria (1938), the Sudetenland (1938) and the Protectorate of Bohemia and Moravia (March 1939); internal boundaries not shown.

properties.name: Poland (eastern provinces)
properties.note: Riga Treaty border of 1921, coarse reconstruction.

properties.name: Soviet Union
properties.note: Non-belligerent toward Germany under the Molotov–Ribbentrop Pact (23 August 1939); invaded Poland 17 September.

properties.name: Hungary
properties.note: Revisionist, aligned with the Axis but not yet a belligerent.

properties.name: Slovakia
properties.note: German client state from March 1939; took part in the invasion of Poland.

properties.name: Italy
properties.note: Non-belligerent until 10 June 1940. Albania occupied April 1939.

properties.name: Finland (Karelia)
properties.note: Ceded to the USSR in March 1940. Coarse.

properties.name: Neutral states
properties.note: Includes Yugoslavia and Greece; Egypt and the Levant were under British or French control.
